final_report.summary: Successfully diagnosed and fixed the GlassBox token counting failure that began on 2/15/2026. The root cause was identified as missing workspace path data in the `emit_mission_completed` event emitted by `StageOrchestrator.update_stage()` in `af_engine/orchestrator.py`. Without `mission_workspace` in the event payload, `transcript_archival.py` could not locate the Claude project directory containing `.jsonl` transcript files, causing all missions since 2/15 to record 0 tokens. Four targeted fixes were implemented and validated: (1) orchestrator.py now emits all required workspace fields, (2) transcript_archival.py has multi-layer defensive fallback logic, (3) dashboard_v2.py uses the correct `mission_archiver` module import, and (4) a re-archival script recovered 13,171 tokens across 3 affected historical missions. All 8 adversarial edge-case tests passed and 3 functional integration tests verified the end-to-end fix.
key_achievements: Identified root cause: orchestrator.py emitted MISSION_COMPLETED events without workspace path fields, causing transcript_archival.py to search in the wrong location
Fixed orchestrator.py to include mission_workspace, mission_dir, project_name, created_at, started_at in MISSION_COMPLETED event data
Added multi-layer defensive fallback to transcript_archival.py: event data → mission_config.json → project_name path inference
Fixed broken dashboard_v2.py import: changed `from glassbox.archive_loader` to `from glassbox.mission_archiver`
Recovered 13,171 tokens across 3 historical missions (mission_398c0f96: 5,333; mission_4659a768: 3,648; mission_6b4072c5: 4,190) that had been recording 0 tokens since 2/15/2026
All 8 adversarial edge-case tests passed, confirming robustness for empty event data, malformed JSON configs, missing manifests, and partial event data scenarios
Future missions will automatically record accurate token counts through the fixed orchestrator event pipeline
challenges_overcome: Tracing the failure through multiple layers: from the orchestrator event emission, through the integration handler, to the path resolution logic in transcript_archival.py
Locating the correct Claude project directory naming convention (URL-encoded path format: -home-vader-AI-AtlasForge-workspace-GlassBox)
Ensuring historical re-archival did not corrupt existing data while recovering the lost token counts
Designing adversarial tests that validated real system behavior rather than mocked scenarios
Correcting 2 path issues discovered during adversarial test harness execution before final validation
lessons_learned: Event-driven integrations are fragile: when an event schema changes (fields are removed or renamed), downstream handlers silently fail rather than raising errors — adding schema validation or required-field assertions to event emission would catch this class of bug immediately
Defensive fallback chains in path resolution are essential: the 3-layer fallback (event data → config file → name inference) means a single missing field does not break the entire pipeline

Token counting failures are silent and cumulative: zero-token missions appear valid in the dashboard but cause compounding data loss over time — an alerting threshold (e.g., warn if new mission archives <100 tokens) would surface this class of regression faster
Historical data recovery is viable if transcript .jsonl files are preserved: the Claude project directory structure is deterministic, making retroactive re-archival reliable
Import errors in dashboard_v2.py can silently fail token display without raising visible errors at startup — import verification tests for dashboard modules would prevent this
The correct GlassBox module for archive loading is `glassbox.mission_archiver`, not `glassbox.archive_loader`
